step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram represents the Singapore Exchange (SGX) Investor Portal architecture. The frontend web flow starts from USERS connecting to CloudFront, which integrates with WAF, Lambda@Edge (for header security and edge compute), and S3 (hosting web artifacts). The API/backend flow starts from USERS making requests to API Gateway. API Gateway invokes a custom Lambda Authorizer that interacts with ElastiCache to validate sessions. Authenticated API traffic routes through ELB to backend microservices running on EC2 instances, which also interact with ElastiCache for session data. Direct Connect (DX) provides a dedicated connection to the On-Premises Data Center (DC).
